mappings.qualification: Shipped ASCII token/name domain with readable world/system/spawn tables; count<=0 maps to an empty resolved token array. World pointer identity is portable rather than a numeric process address. Machine code464a88 uses primary spawn index after testing secondary eligibility; preserved, including primary reread after the first release. Eligible secondary with absent primary or active name matching with absent world faults natively and is excluded. Current world pointer is cached before parsing; release may replace global current world without affecting this caller name-table reference. Mutable release cases also swap players, replace primary, change spawn name and disable secondary. Named activation/deactivation, player release and build-failure physical effects remain explicit services. This module recovers graph orchestration, not those service internals. Managed replay pending.
